primary_sources.title: Hatcher, Notes on Basic 3-Manifold Topology, retained version
primary_sources.used_statement: Proposition1.13 essential vertical annulus in the trefoil, Lemmas1.14-1.15 boundary fibre uniqueness with all exceptions; PF77 retains the complete PDF15 Theorem1.9 JSJ audit. Terminal Klein alternative is handled explicitly by its boundary group, not fibre uniqueness.

primary_sources.title: Waldhausen, On irreducible 3-manifolds which are sufficiently large, Ann Math87(1968),56-88
primary_sources.used_statement: Definition1.1.7 sufficiently large means existence of an incompressible surface; the trefoil essential vertical annulus supplies one. Theorem6.1 relative covering recognition as in PF77, full peripheral map, irreducible/boundary-irreducible exteriors, aspherical sufficiently-large target, one boundary excludes closed-surface product, pi1 isomorphism forces degree1.

PF43/46 characteristic gcd and free-tail construction

new_unbounded_arguments: Actual primitive first D fibre from Euclidean corner transport
All internal D bridges have positive negative-chain determinants, so original fibres cannot match
Corner fusion forces consecutive boundary cones
Terminal Klein either survives or fuses in its Mobius fibration, giving an incompatible terminal piece; no alternative slope is assumed absent
Trefoil targets reduce to s1 and s3; forced marked-distance and full-homology contradictions close both
